Chayannaut observes ‘kaalratri’ with solemn tribute to 1971 martyrs
2026-03-26T11:07:51+06:00 | Arts & Entertainment Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/entertainment/music/news/chayannaut-observes-kaalratri-solemn-tribute-1971-martyrs-4135866

One of the country’s leading cultural organisations, Chhayanaut, marked Kaalratri on March 25 with a solemn and distinctive programme, paying homage to the martyrs of the brutal 1971 massacre carried out by Pakistani forces on unarmed Bangalis.

The memorial event began at 8:00pm on Wednesday at the organisation’s cultural centre in the capital. Members of Chhayanaut lit candles and offered tribute through music, creating a poignant atmosphere of remembrance.

Holding candles in their hands, the performers raised their voices in unison, presenting a series of timeless songs including “O Alor Pothojatri”, “Nahi Bhoy Nahi Bhoy”, “Dukkhe Amar Poran Kande”, and “Aguner Poroshmoni”.

To save a flower: Bangladesh’s birth from lyrics and bullets

The 16-minute programme was broadcast live on Chhayanaut’s official Facebook page, allowing audiences across the country to join in the tribute.
